methodology_other:
Dataset: Methodology of source dataset:

"Administrative Divisions dataset was prepared at 1:1,000,000 scale and is the property of General Command of Mapping, Turkey. This dataset was shared through http://www.hgk.msb.gov.tr/u-23-turkiye-mulki-idare-sinirlari.html for humanitarian use only.

The original administrative divisions data was shared as polyline. This was converted to polygon, cleaned and PCODE were assigned jointly by UNHCR and OCHA. The PCODE reference is based on the coding system of incremental increase by alphabetical order."
name: cod-ab-tur
notes:
Türkiye administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 81 Province (İl)  
- Admin 2: 973 District (İlçe)  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 16 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 01 January 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 30 March 2014: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 30 March 2014: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
